verdict.rationale: Microsoft Entra Domain Services documents managed LDAP and Kerberos/NTLM authentication for legacy cloud applications that can't use modern authentication, which covers the cloud-LDAP half of the story. The evidence never mentions a RADIUS endpoint or serving VPN and Wi-Fi authentication. The 'without a VPN' remote-access item is a different capability and gets no credit here. missing for 10: RADIUS endpoint support, documented VPN/Wi-Fi authentication integration, in-depth LDAP endpoint documentation (secure LDAP, scope), independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an IT admin, legacy protocols still work — cloud LDAP and RADIUS endpoints serve the VPNs, Wi-Fi, and older systems that will never speak SAML

citations.quote: Microsoft Entra Domain Services provides managed domain services like group policy, LDAP, and Kerberos/NTLM authentication. It's designed for legacy applications in the cloud that can't use modern authentication methods.
